title: Hallmark Peanuts Snoopy Santa Bean Bag Plush Christmas - New
descriptionText: The Hallmark Peanuts Collection Bean Bag Plush Christmas Santa Snoopy is a charming 7" plush toy featuring the beloved character Snoopy from the Peanuts franchise. Made from plush material, this collectible item is sure to delight fans of the iconic comic strip. Perfect for festive holiday decor or as a cute addition to a collection of animation merchandise, this Hallmark product brings a touch of nostalgia and whimsy to any home.
